diagram_candidates.claim: The separate explicit and lower-triangular implicit tableaus define three stages, with two implicit solves at the nonzero diagonal stages.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw two aligned 3-stage tableaus with row/column labels 1,2,3 and vectors b,c; connect them to stage boxes Y1,Y2,Y3. Check explicit coefficients γ, δ, 1−δ and implicit coefficients γ,1−γ against the displayed matrices; make clear the Y2 and Y3 diagonal solves and that y+=Y3.

diagram_candidates.claim: Fine and coarse maps F_n and G_n advance the same admitted start state across each common macro interval [t_n,t_{n+1}], generating separate sequential trajectories.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw macro nodes t0,...,tN, with each F_n and G_n arrow from D_n^F or D_n^G into X across the same interval; show the x_n and coarse trajectory separately. Check map direction, common time interval, and that the diagram does not imply accuracy or convergence.

diagram_candidates.claim: For h=τ/m, the delay query Y_{n−m} shifts back exactly one block, yielding first-block values Y_j and second-block recurrence Y_{m+j+1}=Y_{m+j}+ahY_j.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw history through 0, then blocks [0,τ] and [τ,2τ], grid spacing h, and delayed arrows from index n to n−m. Annotate exact first-block solution and second-block recurrence; verify index alignment and endpoint formula at 2τ.

diagram_candidates.kind: CTMC transition graph with killed lift
diagram_candidates.claim: The full chain permits 0→1→2→1, while the projection F={0,1} sends first exit to an absorbing cemetery state and records it as c_F.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw original chain states 0,1,2,… with rates 0→1:1, 1→0:1, 1→2:1, 2→1:2; alongside the killed lift 0↔1 and 1→†:1 with † absorbing. Label lifted column generator and identify c_F(t)=P(τ_F≤t); distinguish cemetery absorption from return in the original chain.

diagram_candidates.claim: At x*=(1,0), the unit-circle orbit tangent is f(x*)=(0,1); ψ_b=x−1 has a tangent level set and singular border, while ψ_g=y is transverse and gives an invertible border.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw the unit circle, clockwise/counterclockwise direction consistent with θdot=1, mark x*=(1,0), orbit tangent upward, and the level sets x=1 and y=0. Check that x=1 is tangent at x* and y=0 crosses transversely; label the radial multiplier e^(−2π) and neutral multiplier 1 only if useful.

diagram_candidates.claim: A perturbation shifts the guard-crossing time by δτ=−D_xg δx^−/κ; reset and post-event flow then produce the same-clock variation Sδx^− with the displayed sign convention.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw incoming trajectory crossing g=0 at τ, perturbed crossing at τ+δτ, reset map R, outgoing vector fields f−/f+, and compare both outgoing states at t0=max(τ,τδ). Check the numerator f+−D_xR f−−∂tR, denominator κ=∂tg+D_xg f−, and column-times-row product.
